package consumer

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.invalid/navbar-proof/converted"
)

func TestDeliveredNavbarConsumer(t *testing.T) {
	defaults, err := os.ReadFile("converted/defaults.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var unbound converted.Navbar
	if err := json.Unmarshal(defaults, &unbound); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if c, err := converted.NewNavbar(unbound); err == nil || c != nil {
		t.Fatal("unbound defaults accepted")
	}
	data := converted.Navbar{
		IDPrefix: "fixture-nav", Label: "Primary navigation", MobileLabel: "Open navigation",
		Brand:         converted.NavbarBrand{LightURL: "/assets/brand-light.svg", DarkURL: "/assets/brand-dark.svg", Alt: "Synthetic company"},
		Links:         []converted.NavbarLink{{Key: "dashboard", Label: "Dashboard", URL: "/dashboard"}, {Key: "projects", Label: "Projects", URL: "https://example.test/projects"}},
		CurrentKey:    "projects",
		Notifications: &converted.NavbarDestination{Label: "Notifications", URL: "/notifications"},
		Account:       &converted.NavbarAccount{Label: "Open account menu", ImageURL: "/assets/avatar.jpg", Links: []converted.NavbarDestination{{Label: "Profile", URL: "/profile"}, {Label: "Settings", URL: "/settings"}}},
	}
	component, err := converted.NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var typed bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &typed); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	oracle, err := os.ReadFile("typed-oracle.html")
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(typed.Bytes(), oracle) {
		t.Fatal("standalone render differs from private compiler oracle")
	}
	if strings.Count(typed.String(), `aria-current="page"`) != 2 || strings.Count(typed.String(), `href="/dashboard"`) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("paired navigation contract changed")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("typed.html", typed.Bytes(), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data.CurrentKey, data.Notifications, data.Account = "", nil, nil
	component, err = converted.NewNavbar(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var minimal bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &minimal); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, absent := range []string{"el-dropdown", "el-menu", "aria-current", "/notifications", "/profile", "/assets/avatar.jpg"} {
		if strings.Contains(minimal.String(), absent) {
			t.Fatal("optional behavior remains in minimal navigation")
		}
	}
	if strings.Count(minimal.String(), `href="/dashboard"`) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("minimal primary navigation lost")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("minimal.html", minimal.Bytes(), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
